stimulus: Pre-padded abc, standard double-block vector, empty message, 55 ascending bytes, 128 patterned bytes, and binary data after a mid-compression reset.

specification.requirement: The core processes pre-padded 512-bit blocks using five 32-bit state words and returns the 160-bit digest.

coverage.reason: No per-test RTL coverage instrumentation in this initial slice; no coverage or Ochiai eligibility claimed.

scope: sha1_core and sha1_w_mem with the RTLProbe extended deterministic core suite

test_metadata.checker: Seven 160-bit digest comparisons on the DUT output, across six deterministic message tests.
test_metadata.source_mapping: semantic assignment/checker relation, not measured coverage

dossier_notes: Upstream RTL and the archived upstream bench are unchanged at the pinned BSD-2-Clause revision. RTLProbe supplies a separately hash-bound testbench. It independently compares the final digest after the second block. Inputs arrive pre-padded. Bus interface, padding generation and per-line coverage are outside this scope.
